question: Can a reverse diode across branch protection reuse the existing common brake candidate without exceeding the servo 6 V constraint?
method: One component datasheet review and algebraic voltage budget using archived brake and wire results; no new motor assumptions or transient simulation
stop_condition: Evaluate archived four brake states once at the existing 1 A comparison point; reject promotion if voltage budget is negative or fault path incomplete
limits: 1 A is a comparison point, not established hardware maximum
Datasheet forward drop maximum applies only at its stated junction temperature
Archived brake waveform is behavioral, not a guaranteed implemented clamp
Branch protection open plus brake path open is a combined fault, retained explicitly rather than described as a single fault
